case_number: 2025 INSC 366; CIVIL APPEAL NO. OF 2025 [@ SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (CIVIL) NO.1114 OF 2019]
summary: Motor accident compensation; deceased aged 45 per post-mortem; monthly income recalculated at Rs.7,000 (pension + notional home-maker wage); multiplier 14 applied; loss of love and affection enhanced to Rs.2,40,000 (Rs.48,000 x 5 claimants) per Pranay Sethi; funeral expenses doubled to Rs.20,000; loss of care and guidance subsumed; future prospects considered; compensation revised upward.
legal_provisions_cited: Sarla Verma v Delhi Transport Corporation, (2009) 6 SCC 121
National Insurance Company Limited v Pranay Sethi, (2017) 16 SCC 680
Rajendra Singh v National Insurance Company Ltd., (2020) 7 SCC 256
Magma General Insurance Co. Ltd. v Nanu Ram, (2018) 18 SCC 130
Lata Wadhwa v. State of Bihar, (2001) 8 SCC 197
final_judgment: Compensation revised and enhanced; appeal allowed in part; High Court award modified.
